boundary: P0/P1 shadow-only. All execution-authority flags default OFF. Shadow/observe flags default ON (log-only).

FLAG_SHADOW.description: Classifier sidecar predicts + logs only. Never routes execution.

FLAG_FLOOR_OBSERVE.description: Safety detector logs floor signals only. Never enforces profile.

FLAG_FLOOR_ENFORCE.description: P2+: enforce effective=max. MUST remain false during P0/P1.

FLAG_ADAPTIVE_ROUTER.description: P2+: adaptive router gains execution authority only after G-PROMOTE-ROUTER.

FLAG_PREDEPLOY.description: P2+: PRE_DEPLOY_PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION gate. OFF in P0/P1.

FLAG_DAG.description: P3+: DAG scheduler execution. OFF in P0/P1.

FLAG_CACHE_V2.description: P6: strong cache keys. OFF in P0/P1.

FLAG_STATE_V2.description: P12: event/projection cutover. OFF in P0/P1.

execution_authority.current_router: first-match table in .opencode/agent/primary.md (sole authority during P0/P1)
execution_authority.adaptive_router: shadow only during P0/P1; fallback-only after promotion per Stage 3 v2
